name: Rearwin Sportster / Cloudster / Skyranger
summary: Prewar two-seat, strut-braced high-wing cabin monoplane from Kansas City; a compact tourer with large windows and a tail enlarged to meet spin requirements.

engines: Single small radial or flat-four in a rounded cowl
fuselage: Fixed gear with a tailwheel or tail skid

tellTales: Compact strut-braced high-wing with a big window area
Rounded, 1930s-style cabin on fixed taildragger gear

confusedWith.howToTell: The Rearwin has a roomier, more glazed cabin with a larger vertical tail; the Taylorcraft is slimmer.
The Rearwin has older, more upright 1930s lines; the Chief is rounder and postwar.
The Rearwin is fabric-covered with struts; the Luscombe is all-metal with a polished skin.
The Rearwin has side-by-side seating; the Cub has tandem seating.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
